items.title: 16.7 Capacitor mein stored energy (jama tawanai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.7 with the V-Q graph and Examples 16.7-16.8 (PDF 74-76).

blocks.text: Capacitor charge jama karne ki device hai. Isay electrical energy jama karne wali device bhi samajh sakte hain, kyunke plates par charge rakhne ke liye work karna parta hai, aur yahi work plates ke charge ki electrical potential energy ban jata hai.

Charged capacitor mein energy hone ka achha proof (saboot) us ka discharge hai. Agar charged capacitor ki plates ko moti taar se jor dein to charge aik plate se doosri plate par beh kar ulte charge ko khatam (neutralize) kar deta hai, aur taar garam ho jati hai. Garmi energy ki aik shakal hai, is liye charged capacitor mein energy thi jo garmi ban kar nikli.
Ab graph ki madad se capacitor mein jama energy nikalte hain. Hum parh chuke hain ke plates ka charge Q potential V ke saath barhta hai:

Is liye V aur Q ka graph origin se guzarne wali seedhi line hai (Fig. 16.10). Charging ke dauran har chhota charge rakhne se plates ka potential difference barh jata hai, is liye agla chhota charge lane mein pehle se zyada work lagta hai. Yani har hisse ka work alag hai.
Is mushkil ka hal: graph ke neeche wale area ko bohat patli pattiyon mein baant dein, har patti ka charge ΔQ. Potential V₁ par chhota charge ΔQ plates tak le jane ka work:

blocks.alt: V aur Q ka graph: origin O se B tak seedhi pink line, B Q-axis ke point A ke oopar. Line ke neeche delta Q width (chaurai) ke das patle rectangles (mustateel) seerhi banate hain; V1 level wala aik rectangle hatched (lakeeron se bhara) hai. Dotted lines V-axis par V1 aur aakhri potential V dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.10: Charge hote capacitor ka V-Q graph (kitab mein Fig. 16.15 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is graph par 'Fig. 16.15' likhti hai jabke text Fig 16.10 kehta hai, aur horizontal axis (ufqi mehwar) ke neeche 'time' bhi chhapa hai. Yeh axis time nahi, charge Q hai. Har patla rectangle delta Q charge ko V1 potential par le jane ka work (delta Q)(V1) hai; sab ka jor triangle (tikon) OAB ka area hai, yani W = (1/2)QV. (Text is rectangle ko 'red' kehta hai; kitab ki figure mein yeh lakeeron se bhara (hatched) hai.)

ΔQ rakhne ka yeh work capacitor ki electric potential energy mein increase (izafa) ban kar jama hota hai. (ΔQ)(V₁) figure mein dikhaye gaye aik rectangle (patti) ka area hai. Capacitor ko aakhri charge Q tak charge karne ka kul work tamam pattiyon ke area ka jor hai, aur Fig. 16.10 dikhati hai ke yeh jor graph ke neeche poora area hai, yani right angled triangle OAB ka area.

blocks.text_alt: Area of triangle OAB = ½ (base) (height) = ½ (OA) (AB)

blocks.text: Yahan OA kul charge Q aur AB aakhri potential difference V hai, is liye:

blocks.text_alt: Area of the triangle OAB = ½QV

blocks.text: Is liye charged capacitor mein jama energy:

Energy ko plates ke charges ki bajaye plates ke darmiyan electric field mein jama bhi samajh sakte hain. Yeh point of view (nazariya) tab kaam aata hai jab charges ki jagah field ki baat karni ho. Iske liye W = ½CV² (Eq. 16.40) mein V = Ed aur C = Aε₀εᵣ/d rakhein:

blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. (16.41)' likhti hai, lekin kitab mein koi equation 16.41 number wali nahi. Murad W = ½CV², yani Eq. (16.40) hai.

blocks.title: Example 16.7
blocks.problem: 4 μF aur 8 μF ke do capacitors series mein jore gaye aur 100 V supply se charge kiye gaye. Kul charge aur system mein jama energy nikalein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein supply 100 V hai, lekin kitab ke hal mein 120 V rakha gaya, is liye kitab Q = 3.2 × 10⁻⁴ C aur W = 1.92 × 10⁻² J deti hai. Diye gaye 100 V se sahi jawab Q = 2.67 × 10⁻⁴ C aur W = 1.33 × 10⁻² J hain, jaisa oopar hal kiya. Kitab ke jawab sirf 120 V supply ke liye theek hain.

blocks.title: Example 16.8
blocks.problem: 16 μF ka capacitor 100 V tak charge kiya gaya. Is mein jama energy nikalein. Agar potential difference double kar dein to energy kitne guna barhegi?

blocks.text: Energy V² par depend karti hai. Agar V double ho (2V) to energy (2)² = 4 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai 'agar V² double ho'. Sawal V (potential difference) ko double karta hai. W ∝ V², is liye V double karne se energy 4 guna hoti hai; agar V² double hota to energy sirf double hoti.

blocks.prompt: 1 μF ka capacitor 4000 V tak charge hai. Is mein kitni energy jama hai?
